data.description:
## Observation

AGENTS.md says `make test` "selects exactly what CI's gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell selects". The selection markers match, but the installed packages do not:
- CI's gating pytest job installs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui --extra grounding-terraform` (.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, line 495).
- `make install` runs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra metrics` (Makefile, line 101).

Tests guarded by `pytest.importorskip("fastapi")` and similar are therefore skipped locally and only run in CI. On 2026-10-29, `make verify` passed on Gerrit 3141 (19,819 passed, 88 skipped) while CI failed `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_drains_queued_events_on_shutdown`, which `make verify` had skipped because the worktree venv had no fastapi.

vampiric-dollfaced-aurochs fixed the CI side of this (no lane installed the reviewbot extra); the local install was not aligned.

## Plan
1. Make `make install` (and `make worktree`'s provisioning) install the same extras as CI's gating cell, plus `metrics`, by deriving the list from one place both read.
2. Add a test that fails when the Makefile's install extras and the gating cell's extras differ.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A test compares the extras `make install` syncs with the gating pytest cell's extras and fails when they differ.
- [ ] After `make install`, `python -c "import fastapi"` succeeds in the venv.
- [ ] `make verify` in a freshly provisioned worktree reports fewer skips than 88, and none from a missing reviewbot, ui or grounding-terraform package.

## File impact (expected)
- Makefile
- .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml
- tests/unit/ (new parity test)
data.title: make verify skips tests that CI's gating cell runs: make install omits the reviewbot, ui and grounding-terraform extras
